messages:
maria: Quick heads up — SOC asked for a temporary increase in auth logs retention for an ongoing investigation. Can we do a retention freeze + JIT KMS decrypt grants?
aj: We should avoid blanket retention increases. Propose scoped change: auth-* indices only, 30d -> 90d, and JIT KMS grants that auto-expire. Kevin, what's SOC timeframe?
kevin: Need logs for last 60 days at min. We only need auth and anomaly indices. Prefer JIT decrypt so only SOC members can read plaintext. :thumbsup:
linh: From infra side we can snapshot indices to secure-bucket with SSE-KMS using our CMK. Will need an export role and an S3 lifecycle rule. Example export command for reference:
```
aws es export --domain redwood-logs --index auth-* --to s3://redwood-secure-exports/incident-2024-09-10 --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 --compress gzip
```
aj: RBAC note: we should NOT expand security-audit-read. Instead create a scoped role `security-incident-read` tied to an SSO group and index-prefix condition, with max session 1h. PR will include policy examples.
maria: Also need audit trail for who requested/decrypted data: require logging of KMS GenerateDataKey / Decrypt and S3 object-level access to the SIEM. Add those to the acceptance criteria.
audit-bot: NOTICE: KMS key policy change proposal created: PR #512 — please review (https://git.company/pr/512)
kevin: SOC needs immediate access — can we issue a 4h KMS grant to group soc-analysts? I'll DM the member list.
linh: We can issue a grant but prefer ephemeral STS + policy that requires an incident tag. Example IAM policy snippet (for assume-role flow):
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/incident-id": "INC-2024-092"}}
}
```
aj: Operational caution: exporting large indices to the SIEM can blow through ingest quotas and costs. Suggest run a filter pipeline (only auth events with outcome!=SUCCESS if necessary), compress, chunk, and add a rate-limit on the SIEM connector.
maria: Who owns approval for retention bump? Need PO or CISO sign-off for policy exception. @kevin can you get sign-off or escalate?
kevin: I'll pull CISO into thread and get sign-off. If needed we can do a formal exception in GRC.
maria: Good. After approval we'll run the incident playbook: 1) create export job (scoped indices) 2) create scoped RBAC and SSO group mapping 3) issue JIT KMS decrypt grant (time-limited) 4) enable object-level S3 audit -> SIEM 5) revoke grant and record audit notes.
aj: I'll draft the RBAC PR and post to #eng-iam for review, include least-priv policy and session TTL.
linh: Also reminder: exports in S3 with CMK must have lifecycle auto-delete set and deny `s3:PutObject` unless `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms`. Add bucket policy to enforce encryption-in-transit plus SSE.
maria: Target: close all steps within 8h and record in the incident doc. :clock8: 
kevin: Update: CISO approved via DM, provided redacted screenshot; will attach to incident doc. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks — scheduling export for 18:30 PT, I'll post the job id when created.
kevin: thx
